newsitem.title: UK: UK to seek scientific evidence on gene corn.
newsitem.headline: UK to seek scientific evidence on gene corn.

text.p: UK Environment Secretary John Gummer said Britain will insist that the European Union hears all scientific evidence before U.S. genetically-altered corn (maize) is allowed to be imported to the EU.

"My concern is that we must hear European scientists' views before we allow this to enter the EU," he told an interviewer on British Broadcasting Corporation (BBC) radio following publication of a leaked memo from his ministry.

The opposition Labour Party said the memo had said that the UK farm ministry had expressed concern that if the altered corn was used in animal feed it could lead to drug-resistant bacteria forming in the digestive system of livestock, compromising disease treatment in animals and humans. Labour spokesman Nigel Griffiths said that "there must be no question of the product entering this country when it may pose a health threat to consumers."
Gummer said he would be hearing the views of European scientists on the product next Monday, noting that there was concern about its unprocessed form if used for animal feed.
